title: Figma Normalizator IR v1
description: Versioned schema for the semantic, platform-neutral Intermediate Representation (IR) emitted by the Figma Normalizator plugin. IR produced from the same input Figma node MUST always be byte-identical: no timestamps, no random ids, and no non-deterministic ordering of object keys or array elements. Any value that cannot be resolved (a missing token, an unmapped variant, etc.) MUST be recorded as an entry in the nearest `unresolved[]` array rather than silently substituted or omitted. This file is IR schema version 1 (see the `v1` path segment in `$id`); a breaking change to any node shape requires a new `v2` sibling schema.

irNode.description: The discriminated union of every IR node kind. `kind` selects the variant.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Origin metadata for a node, used to diff IR across re-exports of the same Figma file.

nodeId.description: The Figma node id this IR node was derived from.

fileKey.description: The Figma file key the node lives in.

version.description: The Figma file version (or version id) the extraction was performed against.

path.description: Stable ancestor chain of node names/ids from the nearest meaningful root down to (but not including) this node, used for diffing across re-exports.

tokenValue.title: TokenValue
tokenValue.description: A resolved Figma variable/style reference plus its concrete value(s). The optional `symbol` field is reserved for a later stage that will map `token` to a generated design-system symbol name (e.g. "AppTheme.semanticColors.text.base.default"); it is optional and unpopulated in v1 so that adding it later is additive, not a breaking change.

token.description: The raw Figma variable/style path, e.g. "color/text/base/default".

value.description: The concrete resolved value for the mode active at extraction time.

modes.description: Present only when the value is theme-dependent. Maps mode name (e.g. "light", "dark") to the resolved value in that mode.

symbol.description: Reserved for a later stage: the generated design-system symbol name for this token. Optional and unused in v1 (forward-compat placeholder, see schema description).

tokenRef.title: TokenRef
tokenRef.description: Same shape as TokenValue but for typography tokens, which have no single resolved numeric/string value. The optional `symbol` field carries the same forward-compat intent as TokenValue.symbol.

token.description: The raw Figma typography style path, e.g. "typography/body/large".

symbol.description: Reserved for a later stage: the generated design-system symbol name for this token. Optional and unused in v1.

unresolvedEntry.title: UnresolvedEntry
unresolvedEntry.description: Records a value that could not be resolved during extraction (a missing token, an unmapped component variant/property, etc). Every unresolvable value MUST produce one of these rather than a silent substitution or omission.

nodeId.description: The Figma node id where the unresolved value was encountered.

reason.description: A short, stable machine-readable reason code/summary, e.g. "missing-variable-binding" or "unmapped-variant".

detail.description: Optional free-form human-readable detail for debugging.

propValue.title: PropValue
propValue.description: The resolved value of a single Figma component property, used in instance node `props`.

oneOf.title: TextOrBooleanPropValue
oneOf.description: For TEXT and BOOLEAN component properties.

oneOf.title: VariantPropValue
oneOf.description: For VARIANT component properties. `from` is the raw Figma variant property value (e.g. "Style=Primary") kept for traceability back to the source.

sizingPartial.title: SizingPartial
sizingPartial.description: Like Sizing, but either axis may be omitted when only one axis is relevant at a call site (e.g. an instance's layout override).

padding.title: Padding
padding.description: Per-side padding. Any side may be omitted (no padding on that side). `all` may be present instead of/alongside explicit sides as a convenience shorthand from the extractor; consumers should treat explicit sides as overriding `all`.

styledSegment.title: StyledSegment
styledSegment.description: One run of text from Figma's getStyledTextSegments, sharing a single typography/color style.

layoutFieldsPartial.title: LayoutFieldsPartial
layoutFieldsPartial.description: The subset of layout node fields relevant to an instance's call-site layout (sizing, spacing, etc as needed) — NOT the internal styling of the component. Every field is optional; only fields actually relevant at the call site are present.

layoutNode.title: LayoutNode
layoutNode.description: An Auto Layout container resolved to intent (direction/alignment/sizing), not raw Figma enums.

textNode.title: TextNode
textNode.description: A text layer. `text` is a plain string for uniformly-styled text, or an array of StyledSegment when getStyledTextSegments reports mixed-style runs.

instanceNode.title: InstanceNode
instanceNode.description: A component instance. Opaque past this boundary: the instance's internal children are NEVER included, only its resolved properties, named slot content, and call-site layout.

component.description: The mapped design-system component name (e.g. "AppButton"), or null if this component set has no mapping yet.

props.description: Resolved component properties keyed by Figma property name.

slots.description: Named slot content for INSTANCE_SWAP or boolean-gated optional children (e.g. leadingIcon/trailingIcon). A null value means the slot exists but is empty/hidden.

assetNode.title: AssetNode
assetNode.description: A vector or image, represented as an export reference — never inline geometry/path data.

exportRef.description: Suggested filename/drawable name, deterministic from the node name.

overlayNode.title: OverlayNode
overlayNode.description: Absolutely positioned children inside an otherwise auto-layout parent.

listNode.title: ListNode
listNode.description: N identical/near-identical siblings collapsed to one template.

itemCount.description: Count observed in the design; informational only, not a rendering directive.
